title: Microarray analysis of highly purified human decidual NK cells
protocol: Perform microarray analysis on highly purified CD56brightCD16- decidual NK (dNK) cells pooled from healthy elective first trimester terminations (6-10 weeks).
Pool each purified subset from all donors and use to obtain a total RNA extract.
Verify the quality of total RNA used and the cRNA prepared afterwards, by using an Agilent Bioanalyzer.
Confirm that the cRNA samples were fragmented to uniform size before continuing with sample labeling and hybridization procedures.
Perform gene expression profiling on the dNK subset by using a CodeLinkTM Uniset Human 20K I Bioarray.
Hybridize the labeled cRNA samples in duplicate.
Use global normalization for data obtained from the Amersham array.
Calculate mean intensities for each array (Mi).
Calculate the mean intensity across all arrays (Ma).
Normalize individual intensities by multiplying measured intensities with Fi.
Exclude transcripts demonstrating differences greater than 2-fold in duplicate analysis.
Set a minimal normalized hybridization intensity value of 20.
Bring up all intensities below 20 to this minimal value.
